TYPE CHECK: The candidate value "3D7" refers to a specific strain of the malaria parasite *Plasmodium falciparum*.
SOURCE CHECK: The value is present in the text; the "Preparation of P. falciparum proteins for mass spectrometry" section explicitly describes the lysis and processing of "late-stage schizonts" from "P. falciparum blood stage 3D7 (wild type)" parasites for LC-MS/MS analysis.
TRUTH CHECK: While "3D7" is a parasite strain rather than an "immortalized cell line" in the traditional mammalian sense (like HeLa), in the context of proteomics metadata for unicellular organisms, the strain name is the correct identifier for the biological source.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set of extracted values includes "3D7", but the paper also describes the use of the "PfPKGT618Q" mutant strain for the same MS experiments. Therefore, the set is incomplete.
